I wrote `factory/runs/003-reject-tab-and-newline-titles/spec.md` and changed nothing else.

- **Criteria:**
  1. `create_task("\t\n\t")` raises `ValidationError` with "Title is required."
  2. `create_task("\tCall Bob\n")` returns a `Task` titled "Call Bob".
- **Test line:** `Test: app/tests/test_tasks.py::test_sr_1_4_title_of_only_tabs_and_line_breaks_is_rejected`
- **Out of scope:** copied from the issue: the other rules, `summary()`, the Task fields.

**Already true:** `validate_new_task` already calls `.strip()`, which removes tabs and line breaks. Both criteria probably hold before any code change. If so, the new test will pass straight away and the factory's RED gate (the suite must fail with the new test) will stop the run. I noted this in the spec but did not mark it `BLOCKED`, because the issue itself is unambiguous. A person will need to decide what to do if the gate stops the run.
